value.rationale: Hypersimplices form the canonical rank-parameter family of uniform-matroid base polytopes. This exact Gaussian-scale angular observable distinguishes how random Euclidean projections fluctuate across a density interpolation, and its certified nonmonotonicity rules out naive monotone behavior between near-simplex and balanced regimes. The surprising double reversal is a geometric structural phenomenon, not an arbitrary finite slice; the precise quantile-parameter function supports subsequent rank-optimization and shape comparisons. The cube boundary value and general studentized L-statistic mechanism are credited.
